name: Buildpad
title: buildpad.io
shortDescription: Buildpad is a platform designed to assist founders in creating market-driven products efficiently. It offers tools for market research, idea validation, and product development, catering to both seasoned and novice entrepreneurs. An example use case is a startup founder using Buildpad to validate a new app idea before development, ensuring it meets market needs.
